candidates.name: Laft–Gourzin–Bandar Abbas Gas Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: Iran Gas Engineering and Development Co. (IGEDC)

evidence.note: 59-km, 30-inch gas transmission line with a 3-km subsea Persian Gulf crossing (70 m water depth) from Bandar Pol to Bandar Laft on Qeshm Island; supplies Qeshm industries, power plants and residents; described as a first for Iran's gas industry; developer IGEDC; completed.
NIGC/IGTC annual commissioning roundup lists Laft–Gourzin–Bandar Abbas among lines brought online in Iranian year 1403 (37 km commissioned, further expansion planned).

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for a Qeshm Island / Bandar Abbas–Laft–Gourzin gas line. Distinct dedicated 30-inch transmission line with a subsea crossing; not any IGAT trunk. Strongest lead.

candidates.name: Minab–Sirik Gas Pipeline
aka: part of Minab–Kuhmobarak / Kuh Mubarak gas line

evidence.note: NIGC/IGTC annual commissioning roundup lists Minab–Sirik at 121 km, 42-inch diameter, among lines commissioned in Iranian year 1403.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for Minab–Sirik. Distinct 42-inch Hormozgan coastal trunkline (Minab–Sirik–Kuhmobarak) tied into IGAT-7 (P0446) and feeding the eastern coast toward Jask. Borderline: it is the domestic feeder segment for the Iran–Oman export scheme (P2225 Rudan→Sohar), but is a separate physically-distinct line — consolidator to decide whether it folds into P2225 or stands alone.

candidates.name: Ardebil–Garmi Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: NIGC/IGTC annual commissioning roundup lists Ardebil–Garmi at 77 km, 24-inch diameter, commissioned in Iranian year 1403.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for Ardebil–Garmi. High-pressure NW-Iran transmission line; borderline on diameter (24 in) but reported by the TSO as a transmission line, not distribution — emitting per pre-filter rule.

candidates.name: Qom–Mohammadieh–Parchin Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: NIGC lists Qom–Mohammadieh–Parchin among >1,700 km of high-pressure transmission lines then under construction; no length/diameter given.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for Qom–Mohammadieh–Parchin. NIGC-listed high-pressure transmission line serving the Qom–Tehran corridor; specs unconfirmed and no second independent source found — weaker lead, but a distinct ministry-listed transmission project.
